name: matching-card-bootcamp
description: ### Goal: Make a 10 card memory game - users must be able to select two cards and check if they are a match. If they are a match, they stay flipped. If not, they flip back over. Game is done when all cards are matched and flipped over. Example: http://www.fruit-burst.co.uk/fun-and-games/pairs-game
author: Jesulayomi <jesulayomi081@gmail.com> (https://www.jesulayomi.tech/)
